R9.reason: The 1.5" setting covers the 2x8 top (1 1/2" actual, §9). The base joints are pocket-hole joins on 3 1/2" 4x4 parts (corrected cutList[1..3]) with a Kreg HD/R3 system, and no setting or screw size is stated for them in any step or material (materials list only 2 1/2" and 2" soft wood screws).

R14.reason: Cut list has 3 base pieces (A x1 at 26 + B x2 at 24 1/4) but steps[5] cuts 2 base beams, both 26" on the long edge. steps[7] then splits one beam in the middle by 3 1/2" ('cut 3.5" out of the very middle'), and the viewed step image shows the halves are short (about 11"), not 24 1/4". Cut list and steps disagree on count and length of the base beams. (c) hardware items all in materials; (a) top: 8 boards x 7" = 56" >= 54" diameter, ok.
